items.title: Timing confusion denies Iraqi weightlifter Asian gold
items.desc: Shafaq News- Nagoya Iraqi weightlifter Ali Ammar won silver in the men’s +110kg event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Tuesday, finishing one kilogram short of gold after timing confusion left him rushing his final clean-and-jerk attempt. Ammar set a world record with a 219kg snatch before lifting 246kg in the clean and jerk for a 465kg total. Iran’s Ali Davoudi won gold with 466kg.
